description:
This Thursday, investigative researcher and health freedom activist Alix Mayer joins VSRF Live to walk through her timeline and analysis of the 2025 West Texas measles story—what happened, how it was framed, and the unanswered questions she believes the public deserves to see. Mayer, the Chairman of Free Now Foundation and former co-founder/leader of CHD’s California chapter, has been presenting new materials and interviews challenging key parts of the early-year narrative and its political/media aftermath.Show more What we’ll cover in this episode:
• The timeline & data: How the outbreak began in late January, what official reports say about cases and fatalities, and where Mayer argues gaps or inconsistencies appear.
• Clinical questions: Mayer’s critique of hospital protocols and whether care decisions—not measles itself—could explain severe outcomes in specific cases she reviewed.
• Media & politics: How the coverage evolved, and Mayer’s claim that the story was leveraged to pressure public figures—including RFK Jr.—to adopt specific talking points.
In addition, VSRF's Nurse Angela will come on with the parents of Baby Kit to give an update on the infant's condition. The story of what happened to this precious baby during his 8-month hospital stay (so far!) is nothing short of horrifying! It's a must hear story and Angela flew to Hawaii to help this family rescue their child from the hospital.
